response.sql: WITH acc_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg FROM account a JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id), region_fig AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.acc_avg) AS figure FROM acc_avg aa JOIN district d ON d.district_id = aa.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(figure) AS avg_figure FROM region_fig) SELECT r.region, r.figure, r.figure - o.avg_figure AS excess_over_average, r.figure / o.avg_figure AS ratio_to_average FROM region_fig r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.figure > o.avg_figure ORDER BY r.figure DESC
